name: PostHarvestPro
alternateName: PostHarvestPro: postharvest physiology and technology, quality, shelf life and sensory evaluation in the browser
description: A self-contained, browser-based platform for postharvest physiology and technology: quality, maturity and CIELAB color; deterioration kinetics, Arrhenius, Q10 and shelf life, including time to rejection with censoring; respiration, ethylene, modified atmospheres and precooling; losses along the value chain and mechanical damage; discrimination, affective and descriptive sensory evaluation; factorial and repeated-measures postharvest trials; packaging and cold-storage calculators; and a self-contained report. No installation and no third-party libraries; Spanish and English interface; the data never leave the computer. Every engine was compared against independent implementations in R, published tables or hand calculations: 443 tests and 71,199 comparisons, none failed.
softwareRequirements: A modern web browser; no installation
